body:
**Summary**

ClearAll is hidden when there are no filters. Following on #1455, it can be confusing to have part of the UI appear / disappear, making it disabled is more subtle and is a very common pattern (disabled buttons)

Fix #1530

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @mthuret, @Morhaus and @vvo to be potential reviewers
Should we add a CSS disabled class and style it or use the disabled attribute? I have no preference, opening the discussion
As for tests, what about we only test the optimistic case with enzyme (there are items, we can click on the button) and then just use snapshots for other tests? (items, no items)

title: fix(ClearAll): always display clearAll button, disabled when no filter
